snippet.title: Release Date Trailer | Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
snippet.description:
The release date for Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy is set.
On January 28, 2027, prepare to venture into the Calixis Sector and meet the dire Night Lords. Pray that the God-Emperor will protect you from the horrors that await, Acolyte.

Join the Inquisition:
